parameters.content: WF6 — explicit proposal job only. Renderer is a separate Vercel project; replace its HTTPS URL. Bind Postgres, renderer Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer), and private Supabase Storage credentials. Import migration 006 first. No success state until both storage objects exist and finalize_proposal_bundle commits.

parameters.jsCode: const e=$json;const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;if(!uuid.test(e.job_id)||!uuid.test(e.lead_id)||!uuid.test(e.lease_token))throw Error('Invalid proposal job envelope');return [{json:{schema_version:1,job_id:e.job_id,lead_id:e.lead_id,lease_token:e.lease_token,operation:'proposal',input:{},result:null,warnings:[]}}];

parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_id,j.lead_id,l.title,l.raw_payload->>'organization' AS organization,l.extracted->>'summary' AS summary,l.deadline,
(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',r.requirement_id,'label',r.label,'status',r.status,'evidence',
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('title',m.title,'source_path',m.evidence->>'source_path','quote',r.evidence_quote)),'[]'::json) FROM public.matches m WHERE m.id=ANY(r.evidence_match_ids))) ORDER BY r.requirement_id) FROM public.requirement_judgments r WHERE r.lead_id=j.lead_id) AS requirements,
p.evidence AS public_sources
FROM public.pipeline_jobs j JOIN public.leads l ON l.id=j.lead_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT evidence FROM public.prospects pr WHERE pr.lead_id=j.lead_id ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true
WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.lead_id=$2::uuid AND j.operation='proposal' AND j.state='running' AND j.lease_token=$3::uuid AND j.lease_until>now() AND l.status='matched';

INSERT INTO public.pipeline_artifact_bundles(job_id,lead_id,version,template_instance_id,state) VALUES($1::uuid,$2::uuid,1,'olivesoft-native-v1','exporting') ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET state='exporting',updated_at=now() RETURNING job_id,lead_id,version;

parameters.jsCode: const c=$('Load proposal evidence').first().json;const s=Array.isArray(c.public_sources)?c.public_sources:[];const claims=s.filter(x=>typeof x.url==='string'&&x.url.startsWith('https://')&&typeof x.excerpt==='string'&&x.excerpt.trim().length>30).slice(0,5).map(x=>({url:x.url,excerpt:x.excerpt,claim:x.excerpt.trim().slice(0,Math.min(120,x.excerpt.trim().length))}));const requirements=Array.isArray(c.requirements)?c.requirements:[];if(!requirements.length)throw Error('No persisted requirement matrix');return [{json:{job_id:c.job_id,lead_id:c.lead_id,proposal:{title:c.title,organization:c.organization,summary:c.summary,deadline:c.deadline,requirements,research_claims:claims}}}];

const r=$json;if(r.job_id!==$('Build cited render payload').first().json.job_id||!Array.isArray(r.files)||r.files.length!==2)throw Error('Renderer returned incomplete bundle');const kinds=new Set();return await Promise.all(r.files.map(async f=>{if(!['pptx','pdf'].includes(f.kind)||kinds.has(f.kind)||!Number.isInteger(f.size_bytes)||f.size_bytes<100||f.size_bytes>2097152||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(f.sha256)||typeof f.base64!=='string')throw Error('Invalid rendered file');kinds.add(f.kind);const bytes=Buffer.from(f.base64,'base64');if(bytes.length!==f.size_bytes||(f.kind==='pdf'&&bytes.subarray(0,4).toString()!=='%PDF')||(f.kind==='pptx'&&bytes.subarray(0,2).toString()!=='PK'))throw Error('Rendered file bytes failed validation');const path=`${r.lead_id}/${r.job_id}/proposal.${f.kind}`;const binary=await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(bytes,`proposal.${f.kind}`,f.mime_type);return {json:{job_id:r.job_id,lead_id:r.lead_id,kind:f.kind,mime_type:f.mime_type,size_bytes:f.size_bytes,sha256:f.sha256,storage_bucket:'olivesoft-proposals',storage_path:path},binary:{data:binary}}}));
const f=$('Prepare binary files').item.json;if(!$json.Key)throw Error('Storage did not confirm artifact');return {json:{...f,provider_file_id:String($json.Key)}};

parameters.query: WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb j) INSERT INTO public.pipeline_artifacts(job_id,lead_id,kind,mime_type,size_bytes,storage_bucket,storage_path,provider_file_id,sha256,verified_at) SELECT (j->>'job_id')::uuid,(j->>'lead_id')::uuid,j->>'kind',j->>'mime_type',(j->>'size_bytes')::bigint,j->>'storage_bucket',j->>'storage_path',j->>'provider_file_id',j->>'sha256',now() FROM p ON CONFLICT(job_id,kind) DO UPDATE SET mime_type=excluded.mime_type,size_bytes=excluded.size_bytes,storage_bucket=excluded.storage_bucket,storage_path=excluded.storage_path,provider_file_id=excluded.provider_file_id,sha256=excluded.sha256,verified_at=now() RETURNING id,kind;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json);if(rows.length!==2||new Set(rows.map(x=>x.kind)).size!==2||!rows.every(x=>x.id))throw Error('Both artifact rows are required');return [{json:{job_id:$('Validate proposal job').first().json.job_id,lead_id:$('Validate proposal job').first().json.lead_id,lease_token:$('Validate proposal job').first().json.lease_token,artifact_ids:rows.map(x=>x.id)}}];

if($json.ready!==true)throw Error('Proposal finalization refused');const p=$('Require both rows').first().json;return [{json:{schema_version:1,job_id:p.job_id,lead_id:p.lead_id,operation:'proposal',input:{},result:{stage:'proposal_ready',artifact_ids:p.artifact_ids},warnings:[]}}];
